verdict.rationale: Dropbox exposes a full REST API and SDKs (Python, JS, etc.) with OAuth-based auth that could be scripted into CI/automation pipelines for file operations and webhooks, but there is no explicit documentation of a headless/CI workflow, service-account or non-interactive auth pattern, or CLI tool designed for automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guide, non-interactive/service-account auth flow, official CLI for scripting.
